subject: EU/APAC model fit & benchmark links — post-demo follow-up
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Müller <lena@localize.co>, Ori Almeida <ori@globex-ai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T08:03:00-04:00
Subject: Follow-up + recommended models / prompt pack (EU & APAC)

Hi Lena / Ori — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick write-up of what we discussed and proposed next steps so everyone has the same page. TL;DR: we think a two-track pilot (EU languages + APAC pilot) will answer your key risks (quality on legal/regulatory phrasing in DE/FR, tone control in JA/KO) within a 2–3 week eval window.

What we recommend for the pilot (short):
- EU track (DE/FR/ES): Open-70B-Quant (encoder-decoder cascade) for best fluency + an n-gram-aware reranker for legal formality. Tuned prompt set attached.
- APAC track (JA/KO): Short-context Mistral-Chat-22B quantized for latency; for longer policy-generation, fall back to Open-70B-Quant.
- Safety & hallucination controls: prefix constraints and a post-generation verifier (lightweight grammar/KV-checker) — details in the prompt pack.

Benchmarks and artifacts attached / shared:
- Prompt pack (attached): short/long prompt variants, QA-style checks, and suffix constraints.
- Quick benchmark (shared drive): sample outputs vs. reference (chrF/BLEU + human 1–5 adequacy for 200 samples per locale).
- Pilot SOW draft (attached) with timelines and gating metrics.

Primary asks from your side to scope the pilot:
1) Confirm top priority locales for the first run (we proposed DE, FR, ES, JA).
2) Share a ~200-sample prompt set (we can accept CSV or Google Sheet) reflecting your customer edge cases (legal notices, refund copy, T&Cs).
3) Desired SLA/latency targets (p95 target in ms) and any data residency constraints.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- You confirm locales + sample set by Fri 23 Jul.
- We run a 2-week bench & small human-likert annotation (you can co-review).
- Pilot kickoff call w/ engineering on Mon 02 Aug.

Attachments: 20270719_aisha_prompt-pack_v1.zip (prompt sets + sample harness), local-bench-summary_DE_JP.csv (sanitized examples), pilot-sow-draft-Localize-2027.docx

If helpful I can also drop a 10-minute video walkthrough of the prompt pack.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
—
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Lena Müller <lena@localize.co>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T10:26:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + recommended models / prompt pack (EU & APAC)

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear summary. Quick clarifications from our PM side: 
1) Latency: for our UX we need p95 < 450ms for short responses (<120 tokens) in EU. Can you confirm whether the Mistral-Chat option (for JA/KO) meets similar p95 targets when deployed in eu-west?
2) Cost: rough expected token cost delta between the 22B and 70B tracks for the pilot (per 1k tokens) — a ballpark is fine.
3) Data residency: we need logs retained in the EU for EU customer traffic. Does Redwood support region-specific KV caching and audit logs?

Also, the German examples you sent are good — but we need one sample that demonstrates a legal negative clause (refund denial language). Can your team generate 10 DE variants with formality tiers (casual -> legal) so our legal team can sanity-check?

Thanks — Lena
Lena Müller
Head of Product, Localize.co

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T12:02:00-04:00
Subject: internal: quick note on DE legal risk

Aisha / Ben — internal quick note before we respond to Lena: we observed in the sample manual run that the 70B cascade occasionally relaxes 'must include' clauses in legal denials (drops negation scope). Mitigations we should propose: 
- Add explicit suffix templates that force the model to repeat critical negation tokens ("kein Rückgaberecht" / "no refund").
- Run a lightweight NER/negation checker post-gen; flag & rerank candidates that preserve targeted tokens.
- For EU pilot, propose a higher human review ratio (10%) on legal-copy outputs during first week.

I'll prepare 10 DE variants (formality tiers) and attach to aisha reply. Also recommend we flag this in the SOW as a gating quality metric (negation-preservation score on a small holdout).

-Neha

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Müller <lena@localize.co>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-20T09:11:00-04:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up + recommended models / prompt pack (EU & APAC)

Lena — great questions, answers and next artifacts below.

Latency / deployment: Open-70B-Quant p95 for short responses on eu-west (g4dn-like) is ~350–420ms with our continuous-batching config; Mistral-Chat-22B quantized is ~220–300ms. We can provide a short latency SLO table in the SOW.

Cost: very rough pilot delta: 22B ~ $0.35 / 1k tokens; 70B ~ $1.10 / 1k tokens (depends on quantization/profile). We will refine after you pick the exact batch/seq targets.

Data residency / logs: yes — Redwood Private supports EU-only log retention and region-specific KV caches and audit trails. We'll flag this in the SOW and include the retention TTL you request.

DE variants: attached "10_DE_variants_formality.csv" (included inside the prompt-pack zip) — we generated 10 denial phrasing variants (casual -> legal) and added suffix templates designed to preserve negation. We also added a post-generation validation step (negation-checker) to the prompt pack; code stub and reranking rules are in the pack.

Benchmarks summary (sanitized):
- DE (200 samples): chrF = 0.64, BLEU = 22.5, human adequacy mean = 4.1/5. Negation-preservation holdout = 94% on the top-1 after reranker.
- JP (200 samples): chrF adapted = 0.58, human adequacy = 3.9/5.

Next suggested milestones:
1) You confirm locales + share your 200-sample customer CSV by Fri 23 Jul.
2) We run 10-day bench + native human annotations (we can share annotator guidelines).
3) Joint checkpoint and go/no-go on Mon 02 Aug.

I re-attached the prompt-pack zip and the pilot SOW draft to this thread. Will schedule a 30-min pilot planning call — proposed times Tue 27 Jul 9:00 CEST or Wed 28 Jul 14:00 CEST. Which works for you?

Cheers,
Aisha

From: Lena Müller <lena@localize.co>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Ori Almeida <ori@globex-ai.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T15:18:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + recommended models / prompt pack (EU & APAC)

Aisha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the DE variants. We're happy to proceed with the pilot on the proposed locales: DE, FR, ES, JA.

Availability: Tue 27 Jul 9:00 CEST works for the planning call. We'll drop the 200-sample CSV into the shared Drive folder by EOD Fri 23 Jul.

Two quick asks before the kickoff: 
- Can you add a short paragraph in the SOW about the gating metric (negation-preservation score) and proposed threshold (we'd like >= 92% on top-1 after reranker)?
- For the human annotations: can we include one of our legal reviewers for the DE batch? We'll coordinate access.

If those are okay, consider this a verbal go for pilot. Looking forward to Tue.

Best — Lena
